# Panelist at Bio International Convention 2025


Jun 16, 2025


### Beth J. Hoffman, PhD, Founder and CEO of Origami Therapeutics, Inc. was a panelist for:


## Next-Generation Alzheimer’s Disease Therapies


As the search for effective treatments for Alzheimer’s disease intensifies, join us for a compelling panel discussion on the next-generation therapies reshaping the landscape of this devastating condition. Experts in neuroscience, pharmacology, and clinical research will explore the latest breakthroughs in drug development, including novel mechanisms of action and innovative therapeutic approaches that go beyond traditional treatment paradigms. This session will delve into the promising advancements in biologics, small molecules, and disease-modifying therapies, as well as the potential of combination therapies and personalized medicine strategies. Panelists will discuss ongoing clinical trials, emerging biomarkers, and the importance of early detection in improving treatment outcomes.
